data.data.field.CA-EmergencyApps.label: CA-EmergencyApps
data.data.field.CA-EmergencyApps.tip: The application or group of applications this contingency policy applies to
data.data.field.Version.label: Version
data.data.rule.azure-logic-apps.name: Logic Apps
data.data.rule.azure-logic-apps.description: Azure Logic Apps naming per CAF. Logic app name 1–43 characters, alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, periods and parentheses, must start with letter or number.
data.data.field.Instance.label: Instance
data.data.rule.azure-resource-group.name: Resource Group
data.data.rule.azure-resource-group.descripti: Azure Resource Group naming per CAF. Resource group name 1–90 characters, alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, periods and parentheses, cannot end with period.
data.data.rule.azure-sentinel-workspace.name: Sentinel Workspace
data.data.rule.azure-sentinel-workspace.descr: Azure Sentinel Workspace naming per CAF. Workspace name 1–63 characters, alphanumeric and hyphens, must start with letter or number.
data.data.rule.azure-virtual-machine.name: Virtual Machine
data.data.rule.azure-virtual-machine.descript: Azure Virtual Machine naming per CAF. Virtual machine name 1–15 characters (Windows) or 1–64 characters (Linux), alphanumeric and hyphens, cannot contain only numbers, cannot end with period or hyphen.
Azure Virtual Network Gateway naming per CAF. Gateway provides cross-premises connectivity via VPN or ExpressRoute.
Virtual Network Gateway. Gateway name 1–80 characters, alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores and periods, must start with letter or number.
Virtual Network Gateway IP. Public IP name for the gateway, 1–80 characters, alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores and periods.
data.data.rule.azure-virtual-network.name: Virtual Network
data.data.rule.azure-virtual-network.descript: Azure Virtual Network naming per CAF. Virtual network name 2–64 characters, alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores and periods, cannot start or end with underscore, cannot contain consecutive special characters.
data.data.rule.azure-virtual-subnets.name: Virtual Subnets
data.data.rule.azure-virtual-subnets.descript: Azure Subnet naming per CAF. Subnet name 1–80 characters, alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores and periods, must start with letter or number.
data.data.rule.ca-emergency-policy.name: Conditional Access Policy - Emergency
data.data.rule.ca-emergency-policy.descriptio: Use for break-glass contingency policies. Keep in Report-Only mode until a disruption occurs.
data.data.field.PolicyId.label: Policy
data.data.rule.ca-extended-policy.name: Conditional Access Policy - Extended
data.data.rule.ca-extended-policy.description: Use for full context policies. Includes Platform and Version segments not available in the Microsoft Recommended pattern. Recommended when platform-specific targeting or change tracking is required.
data.data.rule.defender-antispam-policy.name: Defender Anti-Spam Policy
data.data.rule.defender-antispam-policy.descr: Defender Anti-Spam policy naming per Microsoft 365 governance. Policy name identifies the anti-spam and anti-phishing protection scope, including direction (inbound or outbound) and workload. Follows Defender governance for threat protection.
data.data.field.Direction.label: Direction
data.data.field.ScopeType.label: Scope
data.data.rule.defender-m365-policy.name: Defender for M365 - Other Policies Type
data.data.rule.defender-m365-policy.descripti: Defender for Microsoft 365 policy naming per governance. Policy protects against impersonation, spoofing, and phishing attacks targeting recipients, with consistent naming for audit and operational management.
data.data.rule.defender-quarantine-policy.des: Defender Quarantine policy naming per governance. Policy controls end-user access and notification behavior for quarantined messages, with consistent naming for security operations and user communication.
data.data.field.QuarantineScope.label: Scope
data.data.field.Notify.label: Notify
data.data.rule.entra-app-registration.name: Application Registration
data.data.rule.entra-app-registration.descrip: Microsoft Entra App Registration naming per Microsoft identity governance. App registration name encodes organization, workload, environment and purpose taxonomy for consistent identity lifecycle management and access control.
data.data.rule.entra-app-registration.pattern: Best for single-tenant organisations. Focuses on what the app does, its access level, and deployment environment.
Best for large organisations with department-level segregation. Company and department identify ownership.
Best for MSPs managing multiple customer tenants. Tool is listed first for quick filtering by product.
Best for time-bound integrations. Project name identifies the context instead of the company.
data.data.rule.exchange-room-equip.name: Room Mailbox / Equipment Mailbox
data.data.rule.exchange-room-equip.descriptio: Exchange Resource Mailbox naming per governance. Resource mailbox for bookable rooms or equipment, integrated with Outlook calendar scheduling, with consistent naming for location, floor and resource identification.
data.data.field.City.label: City
data.data.field.Floor.label: Floor
data.data.field.Name.label: Name / Number
data.data.rule.exchange-shared-mailbox.name: Shared Mailbox
data.data.rule.exchange-shared-mailbox.descri: Exchange Shared Mailbox naming per governance. Shared mailbox accessible by multiple users for monitoring and sending from a common email address, with consistent naming for ownership and purpose.
data.data.rule.exchange-distribution-group.de: Distribution List naming per governance. Distribution list for sending email to a defined set of recipients, optionally scoped to internal or external senders, with consistent prefix, scope and department taxonomy for mail flow management.
data.data.field.Prefix.label: Prefix
data.data.rule.groups-m365.name: Microsoft 365 Group
data.data.rule.groups-m365.description: Microsoft 365 Group with a shared mailbox, calendar, and collaboration space across Microsoft 365 services. Supports optional role-assignable or dynamic user membership and a sensitivity label.
data.data.rule.groups-pim.name: PIM / JIT Group
data.data.rule.groups-pim.description: Privileged Identity Management (PIM) Group naming per governance. PIM group for just-in-time access to privileged roles and resources, with consistent naming for audit, eligibility and access reviews.
data.data.field.AccessType.label: AccessType
data.data.rule.group-security.name: Security Group
data.data.rule.group-security.description: General-purpose security group for access control, policy assignment, or resource scoping. Supports optional role-assignable or dynamic user/device membership.
data.data.rule.intune-app-configuration.name: Application Configuration Policy
data.data.rule.intune-app-configuration.descr: Intune App Configuration policy naming per governance. Policy pre-configures settings inside a managed app for enrolled devices or managed apps, with consistent naming for platform, scope and purpose.
data.data.rule.intune-app-protection.name: Application Protection Policy
data.data.rule.intune-app-protection.descript: Intune App Protection policy (MAM) naming per governance. Policy protects organizational data within managed apps independent of device enrollment, with consistent naming for platform, scope and data protection level.
data.data.rule.intune-compliance-policy.name: Compliance Policy
data.data.rule.intune-compliance-policy.descr: Intune Device Compliance policy naming per governance. Policy evaluates whether a device meets organizational security and compliance requirements, with consistent naming for platform, scope and compliance baseline.
data.data.rule.intune-configuration-profile.d: Configuration profile that pushes settings to enrolled devices, such as Wi-Fi, VPN, email, or endpoint protection. Can also cover Intune scripts and remediation scripts.
data.data.rule.endpoint-security-policy.name: Endpoint Security Policy
data.data.rule.endpoint-security-policy.descr: Intune Endpoint Security policy naming per governance. Policy covers antivirus, firewall, attack surface reduction and endpoint detection and response for device security, with consistent naming for profile type and scope.
data.data.rule.teams-project-team.name: Project Team
data.data.rule.teams-project-team.description: Microsoft Teams project team. Team name is the M365 group display name — keep it <=30 characters (the Teams client truncates around 30-36), use '-' or '_' after the prefix, spaces inside the name are allowed.
data.data.rule.teams-department-team.name: Department Team
data.data.rule.teams-department-team.descript: Microsoft Teams department team. Team name is the M365 group display name — keep it <=30 characters (the Teams client truncates around 30-36), use '-' or '_' after the prefix, spaces inside the name are allowed.
data.data.rule.teams-service-team.name: Service Team
data.data.rule.teams-service-team.description: Microsoft Teams service team. Team name is the M365 group display name — keep it <=30 characters (the Teams client truncates around 30-36), use '-' or '_' after the prefix, spaces inside the name are allowed.
data.data.rule.m365-group-naming-policy.name: M365 Group Naming Policy
data.data.rule.m365-group-naming-policy.descr: Entra ID group naming policy format applied to Microsoft 365 groups (and therefore Teams). Prefix and suffix strings are restricted at policy creation; blocked words (list up to 5000) are rejected automatically.
data.data.field.GroupName.label: Group Name
data.data.field.GroupName.tip: Avoid emojis. Blocked words configured in the Entra naming policy are rejected automatically.
data.data.lib.teams/entra-attributes.[Office]: Office location attribute from Entra ID
data.data.lib.teams/entra-attributes.[StateOr: State or province attribute from Entra ID
data.data.lib.teams/entra-attributes.[Country: Country or region attribute from Entra ID
data.data.lib.teams/entra-attributes.[Title]: Job title attribute from Entra ID
data.data.rule.spo-team-site.name: Team Site (Group-Connected)
data.data.rule.spo-team-site.description: Group-connected SharePoint Team site provisioned at /teams/<url>. The site name becomes the M365 group display name and inherits the Entra group naming policy.
data.data.rule.spo-communication-site.name: Communication Site
data.data.rule.spo-communication-site.descrip: SharePoint Communication site provisioned at /sites/<url>. The title can be renamed later independently of the URL.
data.data.rule.spo-hub-site.name: Hub Site
data.data.rule.spo-hub-site.description: SharePoint hub site. Microsoft recommends a consistent, discoverable naming convention for hub sites, e.g. '<Function> Hub'.
data.data.field.SiteName.label: Site Name
data.data.field.SiteName.tip: URL name: lowercase, hyphenated, no spaces. Group-connected sites inherit the M365 group naming policy (see Teams category). Total file path stays under 400 chars — keep URLs short.
data.data.rule.pp-environment.name: Power Platform Environment
data.data.rule.pp-environment.description: Power Platform environment naming per governance. Maintain at minimum Dev/Test/Prod. When creating an environment, choose its type explicitly (Sandbox vs Production). Rename the default environment to a descriptive name.
data.data.field.User.label: User
data.data.rule.purview-sensitivity-label.name: Sensitivity Label
data.data.rule.purview-sensitivity-label.desc: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Label naming per governance. Label from classification taxonomy (Personal, Public, General, Confidential, Highly Confidential) with optional sublabel variant, for consistent data classification and protection.
data.data.field.Classification.label: Classification
data.data.field.Classification.tip: Use your tenant's published taxonomy order: Personal > Public > General > Confidential > Highly Confidential.
data.data.field.Sublabel.label: Sublabel
data.data.field.Sublabel.tip: Sublabels inherit the parent label's settings; keep names short, stable, and space-free.
data.data.rule.purview-retention-label.name: Retention Label
data.data.rule.purview-retention-label.descri: Microsoft Purview retention label. The name CANNOT be changed after save — validate the name carefully before creating it.
data.data.rule.purview-retention-policy.name: Retention Policy
data.data.rule.purview-retention-policy.descr: Microsoft Purview retention policy, applied org-wide or to selected locations. Policy names apply after up to a 7-day lead time and cannot be renamed casually — plan names before creation.
data.data.rule.purview-dlp-policy.name: DLP Policy
data.data.rule.purview-dlp-policy.description: Microsoft Purview data loss prevention policy. The name is renamable, BUT old names persist forever in audit and alert records — choose audit-friendly names from the start.
data.data.field.LabelName.label: Label Name
data.data.field.LabelName.tip: Immutable after save: the name cannot be changed later. Double quotes (") are not supported. Label policies can take up to 7 days to apply — get the name right first time.
data.data.field.PolicyName.label: Policy Name
data.data.field.PolicyName.tip: Retention policies take up to 7 days to apply; DLP old names persist in audit records even after rename.
data.data.rule.azure-storage-account.name: Storage Account
data.data.rule.azure-storage-account.descript: Azure storage account naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework — Microsoft's guidance collection for structuring and naming cloud resources). The storage account name IS the public endpoint (e.g. stdatafrcprod001.blob.core.windows.net) and must be globally unique across all Azure tenants — uniqueness itself cannot be checked here. Lowercase letters and numbers only, no hyphens or underscores, 3–24 characters.
data.data.rule.azure-key-vault.name: Key Vault
data.data.rule.azure-key-vault.description: Azure Key Vault naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework — Microsoft's guidance collection for structuring and naming cloud resources). Vault names are publicly resolvable and globally unique: 3–24 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only, must start with a letter, end with a letter or number, and never contain consecutive hyphens.
data.data.rule.azure-network-security-group.d: Azure Network Security Group naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework — Microsoft's guidance collection for structuring and naming cloud resources).
data.data.rule.azure-public-ip.name: Public IP
data.data.rule.azure-public-ip.description: Azure Public IP naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework — Microsoft's guidance collection for structuring and naming cloud resources).
data.data.rule.azure-container-registry.name: Container Registry
data.data.rule.azure-container-registry.descr: Azure Container Registry naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework — Microsoft's guidance collection for structuring and naming cloud resources). The registry name is globally unique across all Azure tenants — uniqueness itself cannot be checked here. Lowercase letters and numbers only, 5–50 characters, no hyphens.
data.data.rule.azure-kubernetes-service.name: Kubernetes Service (AKS)
data.data.rule.azure-kubernetes-service.descr: Azure Kubernetes Service naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework). AKS cluster and node pools provide managed Kubernetes for container workloads.
data.data.rule.azure-kubernetes-service.patte: AKS cluster. Cluster name 1–63 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, must start with letter and end with letter or number, no consecutive hyphens. Represents the managed Kubernetes cluster.
AKS node pool. Node pool name 1–12 characters, lowercase letters and numbers, must start with letter. Role identifies the node pool purpose (system, workload, spot).
data.data.rule.azure-cosmos-db.name: Cosmos DB
data.data.rule.azure-cosmos-db.description: Azure Cosmos DB naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework — Microsoft's guidance collection for structuring and naming cloud resources).
data.data.rule.azure-service-bus.name: Service Bus
data.data.rule.azure-service-bus.description: Azure Service Bus naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework — Microsoft's guidance collection for structuring and naming cloud resources).
data.data.rule.azure-service-bus.pattern.name: Namespace (Standard)

Service Bus Standard namespace. Globally unique, 6–50 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, must start with letter and end with letter or number, no consecutive hyphens. Used for messaging and integration.
data.data.rule.azure-service-bus.pattern.queu: Service Bus Queue. Queue name identifies the message queue purpose within a namespace. 1–260 characters, lowercase, hyphenated.
data.data.rule.azure-service-bus.pattern.topi: Service Bus Topic. Topic name identifies the publish/subscribe topic purpose within a namespace. 1–260 characters, lowercase, hyphenated.
data.data.rule.azure-service-bus.pattern.subs: Service Bus Subscription. Subscription name identifies the consumer of a topic within a subscription. 1–50 characters, lowercase, hyphenated.
data.data.rule.azure-function-app.name: Function App
data.data.rule.azure-function-app.description: Azure Function App naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework — Microsoft's guidance collection for structuring and naming cloud resources). The name is globally unique across Azure — uniqueness itself cannot be checked here. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, 2–60 characters.
data.data.rule.azure-app-service.name: App Service
data.data.rule.azure-app-service.description: Azure App Service naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework — Microsoft's guidance collection for structuring and naming cloud resources). The name is globally unique across Azure — uniqueness itself cannot be checked here. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, 2–60 characters.
data.data.rule.azure-sql-server.name: SQL Server
data.data.rule.azure-sql-server.description: Azure SQL Server naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework). Server name is globally unique, 1–63 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, must start with letter and end with letter or number, no consecutive hyphens.
data.data.rule.azure-sql-database.name: SQL Database
data.data.rule.azure-sql-database.description: Azure SQL Database naming per CAF. Database name 1–128 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
data.data.rule.azure-api-management.name: API Management
data.data.rule.azure-api-management.descripti: Azure API Management naming per CAF. Service name is globally unique, 1–50 characters, alphanumeric and hyphens, must start with letter, end with letter or number.
data.data.rule.azure-data-factory.name: Data Factory
data.data.rule.azure-data-factory.description: Azure Data Factory naming per CAF. Factory name 3–63 characters, alphanumeric and hyphens, must start with letter.
data.data.rule.azure-log-analytics.name: Log Analytics Workspace
data.data.rule.azure-log-analytics.descriptio: Azure Log Analytics Workspace naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework). Workspace name 4–63 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, must start with letter and end with letter or number, no consecutive hyphens.
data.data.rule.azure-app-insights.name: Application Insights
data.data.rule.azure-app-insights.description: Azure Application Insights naming per CAF. Component name 4–63 characters (workspace-based) lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, must start with letter.
data.data.rule.azure-event-hub.name: Event Hub
data.data.rule.azure-event-hub.description: Azure Event Hub naming per CAF. Event Hub provides real-time data ingestion and streaming at scale.
data.data.rule.azure-event-hub.pattern.namesp: Event Hub Namespace. Globally unique, 6–50 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, must start with letter and end with letter or number, no consecutive hyphens.
data.data.rule.azure-event-hub.pattern.hub.de: Event Hub entity within a namespace. Hub name 1–50 characters, lowercase, hyphenated, identifies the streaming topic.
data.data.rule.azure-application-gateway.name: Application Gateway
data.data.rule.azure-application-gateway.desc: Azure Application Gateway naming per CAF. Name 4–80 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, must start with letter and end with letter or number, no consecutive hyphens.
data.data.rule.azure-firewall.name: Azure Firewall
data.data.rule.azure-firewall.description: Azure Firewall naming per CAF. Name 4–80 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, must start with letter and end with letter or number, no consecutive hyphens.
data.data.rule.azure-key-vault.field.Workload: IDENTITY: Entra ID, App Registrations, Managed Identities · SHARED: platform secrets shared by multiple apps · APP: single application secrets · WEB: web certificates/secrets · DATA: SQL/Storage/Cosmos keys · DEVOPS: CI/CD secrets · NETWORK: VPN/ExpressRoute/Firewall certs · SECURITY: PKI, encryption keys · MONITORING: Log Analytics/Sentinel · BACKUP: recovery vault.
data.data.field.Instance.tip: Instance number or suffix distinguishing duplicate resources, e.g. 001, 002.
data.data.rule.intune-autopilot-device-name.d: Autopilot device-name template. Hard limit: 15 characters total — Windows enforces it AFTER %SERIAL% / %RAND:n% macros expand at enrollment, so keep static text well under budget. Allowed characters: letters, numbers, hyphens. Note: this app checks allowed characters and typed length, and also flags templates whose %RAND:n% expansion would exceed the 15-character limit — you must still ensure the final name is not all numbers.
data.data.rule.intune-autopilot-device-name.f: Letters, numbers and hyphens only. Static text counts toward the 15-character limit — %SERIAL% expands to the real serial at enrollment, so leave room.

Pick the macro from the list to avoid typos; custom macro strings are allowed. RAND widths are capped to what fits after your Prefix (e.g. DT- caps at %RAND:12%), and the app flags templates whose expansion exceeds 15 characters.

Mix static text and macros (%SERIAL%, %RAND:n%). Count every character as typed — %SERIAL% is 8 characters today but grows at enrollment. The name may not be all numbers; this is not checked automatically.
data.data.rule.intune-group-tag.name: Autopilot Group Tag
data.data.rule.intune-group-tag.description: Intune Autopilot Group Tag naming per governance. Group tag drives dynamic group membership and per-group Autopilot profile assignment, with consistent naming for model, purpose and scope.
data.data.rule.intune-autopilot-profile.name: Autopilot Profile
data.data.rule.intune-autopilot-profile.descr: Windows Autopilot Deployment Profile naming per governance. Profile for consistent device provisioning and dynamic group assignment, with country, device type and purpose taxonomy.
data.data.rule.intune-scope-tag.name: Scope Tag
data.data.rule.intune-scope-tag.description: Intune Scope Tag naming per governance. Scope tag for scoping administrative access to devices and policies, for role-based access control.
data.data.rule.intune-update-policy.name: Update Policy
data.data.rule.intune-update-policy.descripti: Intune Update Policy naming per governance. Policy replaces classic Update Ring taxonomy for consistent update management and compliance reporting.
data.data.lib.intune/autopilot-macros.%SERIAL: Device serial number, expanded at enrollment
data.data.rule.azure-load-balancer.name: Load Balancer
data.data.rule.azure-load-balancer.descriptio: Azure Load Balancer naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework). Load balancers provide high availability and network performance to your applications.
data.data.rule.azure-load-balancer.pattern.in: Internal load balancer for private traffic within a virtual network. Name 4–80 characters, lowercase, hyphenated, internal-facing.
data.data.rule.azure-load-balancer.pattern.ex: External load balancer for public-facing traffic. Name 4–80 characters, lowercase, hyphenated, internet-facing.
data.data.rule.teams-team.name: Team
data.data.rule.teams-team.description: Microsoft Teams team. Team name is the M365 group display name — keep it <=30 characters (the Teams client truncates around 30-36), use '-' or '_' after the prefix, spaces inside the name are allowed.
data.data.rule.pp-environment.pattern.environ: Typed environment for a specific workload and environment.
data.data.rule.pp-environment.pattern.develop: Personal developer environment for an individual user.
Shared environment for a workload and environment, for collaborative scenarios.
data.data.rule.intune-update-policy.pattern.p: Generic platform update policy for staged rollouts.
data.data.rule.intune-update-policy.pattern.w: Windows-specific update policy with stage and purpose for quality, feature, driver or hotpatch updates.
data.data.rule.azure-redis-cache.name: Redis Cache
data.data.rule.azure-redis-cache.description: Azure Redis Cache naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework). The Redis cache instance provides in-memory data store for caching and session state. The name refers to the cache instance itself and must be globally unique where applicable.
data.data.rule.azure-bastion.name: Bastion Host
data.data.rule.azure-bastion.description: Azure Bastion naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework). Bastion provides secure RDP and SSH connectivity to virtual machines without exposing a public IP. The name identifies the bastion host within its virtual network and resource group scope.
data.data.rule.azure-recovery-vault.name: Recovery Services Vault
data.data.rule.azure-recovery-vault.descripti: Azure Recovery Services Vault naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework). The vault secures backup and disaster recovery data for virtual machines and workloads. The name identifies the vault within its resource group and subscription scope for protection policies.
data.data.rule.azure-nat-gateway.name: NAT Gateway
data.data.rule.azure-nat-gateway.description: Azure NAT Gateway naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework). NAT Gateway provides secure outbound connectivity for resources in a virtual network subnet. The name identifies the gateway associated with its subnet and resource group scope.
data.data.rule.azure-synapse-workspace.name: Synapse Workspace
data.data.rule.azure-synapse-workspace.descri: Azure Synapse Analytics workspace naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework). The workspace provides unified analytics for Spark and SQL pools over data lake and warehouse. The name refers to the workspace itself and its analytics pools scope and should be globally unique where applicable.
data.data.rule.azure-cognitive-service.name: Cognitive Service
data.data.rule.azure-cognitive-service.descri: Azure Cognitive Services (Azure AI Services) naming per CAF (Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework). Cognitive Services provide AI APIs for vision, speech, language and decision. The name identifies the service account within its resource group and subscription scope for AI workload governance.
